KCTD19_reassessment: KCTD19 p.G920R is somatic DNA-supported (134/419 tumour DNA reads, AF 0.318; 49/0 WBC normal REF; clonality unestablished without purity, copy-number and mutant-copy-multiplicity deconvolution) and predicts Class I <=500 nM (RSVSYSILR 36.9 nM HLA-A*33:03), but has 0 coding-strand ('-') and 2 opposite-strand ('+') mutant RNA fragments (0 '-' spliced reads in +-20 kb; AlphaGenome 2 tumour RNA score 0.0024). It entered frozen Isovar solely via unstranded read pooling, whereas 7 other paired-normal somatic DNA missense mutations (AF ~0.31-0.38; clonality unestablished) with 0 coding-strand ALT reads at 1-4x local depth were excluded. Shallow 4-fragment coding-strand REF depth does not prove KCTD19 is unexpressed across all lesions, so KCTD19 is downgraded to somatic DNA-only / unconfirmed coding-RNA watch with an author-proposed SG-04 strand-specific RT-ddPCR and a pre-solved 15-region KCTD19-excised protein alternative with complete cached Class-II context coverage in strand-strict-15/.
SERPINA1_policy: Retain as a reserve: S22Y is in the normally cleaved signal peptide and Class I exceeds 500 nM. Conditional Class II scores do not establish presentation of this signal-derived tumor antigen.
core_policy: Main research selection: 12 paired-normal somatic mutation candidates with >=2 coding-strand mutant RNA fragments, FES and SYT12 with one each, and KCTD19 with somatic DNA support but unconfirmed coding-RNA expression and clonality. KCTD19 is retained as an unconfirmed research slot; shallow 0/4 coding-strand coverage does not establish biological silence. The in-frame CDH1::NRG1 fusion is an explicit inclusion exception. No RNA-only splice or intentional-self/CTA region is encoded. A separately optimized 15-region protein alternative excludes KCTD19.
cta_audit_scope: 40 tabulated candidates: 36 codon-supported candidates among ranks 1-84 plus four rejected baseline candidates; not all possible antigens.
cta_score_ratio_formula: ag2_testis / (ag2_vital_max + 0.01); arbitrary pseudocount, not a tissue-expression or safety ratio
fragment_sum_interpretation: In this 15-mutation selection, 245 pooled ALT fragments decompose into 236 coding-strand + 9 opposite-strand fragments. Pooled Isovar counts require strand interpretation in this inferred fr-firststrand library. Counts are not UMI molecules, tumour-cell coverage, clonality or vaccine efficacy.
